title: Cloud agents ship for landing; a company host gates and lands
goal: CEO 2026-11-24 'Company host lands it': cloud agents push to refs/agents/<name>, a company host runs the gates inside the 10s line and fast-forwards main

reuse.searched: Susi Tools' ship (a fast-forward of main), the pre-push rule that already lets an agent publish to refs/agents/<name> moving forward only, claims (a task must be open on main), the Board's post, and gates (T-CLAUDE-7); the cloud probe of 2026-11-24 (Susi's docs/cloud-agents.md): a cloud machine reaches and pushes Artifacts, but its 4 cores take 37.6 s for the gates
reuse.reason: Landing reuses ship's checks, the agent ref the hooks already allow, gates and the Board; new are a landing mode for ship, a claim that finds the task in the agent's own work, and `land`, which gates and fast-forwards main on a host's cores. No dependency.
